review_cost.rationale: Approve after a small round: one real bug fix (the debounce race), a meta-fallback tweak, and three one-line cleanups. Nothing structural.

findings.issue: The debounced search timeout captures the render-time `filters` closure, and the type/generation selects (home.tsx:155,170) don't clear it, so a filter applied within the 150ms window is silently dropped from the URL when the timer fires.
findings.suggestion: Cancel the pending debounce in the select onChange handlers, or better, drive all filters through the documented pattern — a GET <Form> with submit-on-change / useSearchParams — so URL state has a single source of truth.

findings.issue: Meta titles report "Not found – Pokédex" for any loader failure, including 500s; root.tsx:17 gets this right by inspecting the error.
findings.suggestion: Use the `error` field of MetaArgs (available in v8) with isRouteErrorResponse to pick the heading, ideally via one shared helper instead of the copy repeated in move.tsx:15, type.tsx:17 and ability.tsx:14.

findings.issue: The Card type (and the cardsFromPokemon view-model builder) live in the server-only data module but are consumed by client components (ui.tsx:4).
findings.suggestion: Move Card and the card-building helper into a shared non-.server module (e.g. lib/cards.ts) to keep the server fetch/cache boundary clean.

findings.issue: The loader fans out one request per version group plus one per move in the selected game, unbounded.
findings.suggestion: Acceptable against the local cached API, but consider batching or a concurrency cap if the API ever becomes remote.

findings.issue: Duplicates TypeBadge's --type-color variable trick but omits its fallback (ui.tsx:10 uses var(--color-text-muted) as default).
findings.suggestion: Reuse TypeBadge (or extract the color-var helper) so all type coloring behaves identically.

findings.issue: isbot is declared as a dependency but nothing imports it (no entry.server.tsx exists).
findings.suggestion: Remove it, or keep it only if a custom entry.server that uses it is added.

summary: A small, disciplined framework-mode app that uses current React Router 8 idioms — typed route modules, URL-driven loaders, data() 404s, server-only data access, and careful request dedup/caching. The one substantive flaw is a stale-closure race in the home page's hand-rolled search/filter sync, which the documented GET-form/search-params pattern would have avoided. Mergeable after one small round of fixes.
